messages:
maria: Quick thread to capture follow-ups from today's all-hands on why we won/lost deals and the immediate asks from field teams. Short summary: wins = fast migrations + transparent cost math; losses = security integrations, SLA clarity, and unexpected model behavior on long-contexts.

sam: Thanks Maria. From GTM: priority is closing the gap on KMS/SOC2 signals and a simple SLA menu we can share during demos.

pooja: Product ask: we need a standard one-pager migration playbook (prereqs, testing, rollback) and a two-line migration benefit statement for AEs. Can CS share samples of lost-deal notes?

devin: Eng notes: fallback model family + better KV eviction telemetry would reduce a lot of noise. I estimate a small squad can deliver a canary + KV metrics dashboard in 3-4 weeks.

ryan: CS will redact 3 closed-lost deals and post summaries. Also building a template: "What was missing" + "What we can offer next quarter" for AEs.

maria: Leadership Qs: who owns (A) SLA menu and legal signoff, (B) migration one-pager, (C) fallback canary + KV telemetry? Please @ owners.

sam: I'll take (A) and loop legal/security.

pooja: I'll lead (B) with Ryan/Cs input.

devin: I'll own (C). Can product drop the eval prompt set for long-context failure cases by Wednesday?

maria: Yes, I'll upload the eval prompts and traffic profiles to the shared drive. Also creating an action doc with owners/timelines.

ops-bot: Created ticket #RW-789 in infra/serving: "Canary + KV eviction metrics for stability" assigned to devin, linked to thread 2291345790.

maria: Action summary: sam (SLA + legal), pooja/ryan (one-pager + lost-deal samples), devin (canary + telemetry), maria (evals + action doc). Proposed 25m sync Friday 11am. React :thumbsup: if that works.
